title: Hue in a day
summary: Sleep on the south bank. Cross for the Imperial City when the gate opens, eat bún bò Huế at Dong Ba, and at dusk walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh. How long the courts take is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Hue Citadel
stops.note: Morning, at opening. The conservation centre’s notice of 12 March 2024 opens the visiting points at 06:30 from 16 March to 15 October, and at 07:00 from 16 October to 15 March. A reload of that notice timed out on 21 October 2026, so confirm the posted hours. An adult ticket is 200,000 VND. The tombs are not on it.

stops.name: Bun bo Hue
stops.note: Eat bún bò Huế at Dong Ba. Vietnam Tourism and the culture department do not set a clock hour. The market’s street number is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Perfume River walk
stops.note: At dusk, walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh. No fee is published for the path. How long the walk takes is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Hue in a day — citadel opening and the river at dusk
seoDescription: One day in Hue: the Imperial City when the gate opens, bún bò Huế at Dong Ba, and the river walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh at dusk.
